evidence_snippets: Response integrations community contribution guidelines Supported in: Google secops SOAR This document outlines the guidelines for submitting Response Integrations to Google SecOps through community contributions.

Configuration parameters All integrations should contain configuration parameters (API Root + Auth parameters), unless the underlying API doesn't require any authentication and the API Root can be hardcoded.
